PROSPECTUS FOR INITIAL PUBLIC OFFERING OF COMMON STOCK

Example Technology Inc. (a Delaware corporation since 2015)

We are offering 10,000,000 shares of our common stock at a price of $15 per share in this initial public offering.

ITEM 1A RISK FACTORS - Factors That May Affect Our Results

Investing in our common stock involves a high degree of risk and uncertainty.

Our business depends on our ability to attract and retain paying customers in a competitive market.

We define "monthly active users" as unique users who access our platform at least once per month via web or mobile.

MANAGEMENT'S DISCUSSION AND ANALYSIS OF FINANCIAL CONDITION AND RESULTS OF OPERATIONS

The following discussion should be read in conjunction with our consolidated financial statements and related notes.

KEY METRICS FOR BUSINESS PERFORMANCE EVALUATION AND MEASUREMENT

We monitor several key metrics to evaluate our business performance and financial condition over time.

Total Customers. As of December 31, 2024, we had 50,000 paid customers, up from 42,000 as of December 31, 2023.

Monthly Active Users. Our monthly active users grew to 5.2 million in Q4 2024, compared to 4.1 million in Q4 2023.

DESCRIPTION OF BUSINESS OVERVIEW OF OPERATIONS AND STRATEGY

We are a leading provider of cloud-based software solutions for modern enterprises and growing businesses.

Our platform serves enterprises across multiple industries including technology, healthcare, financial services, and retail.

Customer Retention. Our dollar-based net retention rate was 120% for the year ended December 31, 2024, indicating strong customer growth.
